articles.title: Chicago White Sox aim to ‘get guys in the best spots’ with rotation tweaks heading into the stretch
articles.description: After Sunday, the Chicago White Sox will have 19 games remaining in the regular season. How the starting pitching performs will play a pivotal role in which team finishes first in the AL Central.

articles.title: Chicago White Sox beat Minnesota Twins 10-1
articles.description: Sam Antonacci had 3 doubles while Randal Grichuk and Kyle Teel homered for the Chicago White Sox in a 10-1 win against the Minnesota Twins on Sunday.

articles.title: Steps Munetaka Murakami is taking to break out of his prolonged slump for Chicago White Sox’s stretch run
articles.description: After batting .147 in 28 games in August, All-Star first baseman Munetaka Murakami is aiming to turn it around to help the Chicago White Sox in their playoff push.

articles.title: Chicago White Sox: Kyle Teel returns from IL for playoff push
articles.description: The Chicago White Sox reinstated Kyle Teel from the IL on Friday. The catcher has played in just 19 games this season because of a various injuries.

articles.title: Chicago White Sox lose 2-0 to the Houston Astros
articles.description: The Chicago White Sox didn’t cash in on multiple chances in the top of the eighth. The Houston Astros responded with a two-out, two-run single and held on to win 2-0.

articles.title: Chicago White Sox lose game — and series — to Houston Astros after another rough outing from Luis Castillo
articles.description: Luis Castillo struggled again in the Chicago White Sox’s 6-2 loss to the Houston Astros on Thursday. He has a 7.52 ERA in six starts since the Sox acquired him last month.

articles.title: Justin Ishbia unveils his plan for a new White Sox ballpark on Railyards site along Chicago River
articles.description: Future Chicago White Sox owner Justin Ishbia unveiled a development plan for a South Loop site that potentially includes a new White Sox ballpark.

articles.title: Miguel Vargas and Colson Montgomery reach 30 homers as the Chicago White Sox top the Minnesota Twins 4-1
articles.description: The Chicago White Sox hit three home runs Friday in a 4-1 win against the Minnesota Twins, but their AL Central lead is down to 2½ games after the Cleveland Guardians swept a doubleheader.

articles.title: Offensive numbers show exactly how the AL Central-leading Chicago White Sox have improved in a year
articles.description: The Chicago White Sox entered Wednesday leading the AL in runs per game (4.78). It’s one of the many areas of improvement for the first-place club.

articles.title: Outfielder Tommy Pham and pitcher Tanner McDougal join the Chicago White Sox as rosters expand
articles.description: The Chicago White Sox recalled pitcher Tanner McDougal from Triple-A Charlotte and selected the contract of outfielder Tommy Pham as MLB rosters expanded on Tuesday.

articles.title: Vintage Chicago Tribune: White Sox’s promising 1994 start — until the season was canceled by the strike
articles.description: Here’s a look back at the Chicago White Sox’s promising 1994 season, from before it began to picking up the pieces during a disappointing post-strike return for the team in 1995.
